global_rules.criterion_form: Vector criteria; no weighted composite score

GW-R.name: Groundwater recharge / long-term exchange
GW-R.spatial_support: Unsaturated-zone lower boundary aggregated to the groundwater application support; exact application population not independently fixed.
rejected_substitutions: Groundwater-model numerical water-balance closure as recharge-representation tolerance
Case-specific achieved recharge estimation error as a universal criterion
A temporal aggregation interval chosen because a candidate happens to pass it

frozen_acceptance_envelope.reason: No independent quantitative recharge bias, cumulative-exchange, seasonal, annual, or drift tolerance with matched temporal semantics was identified.

unresolved_requirements: Purpose-owner quantitative consequence of recharge error
Domain/population to which the requirement applies

GW-D.name: Dynamic groundwater coupling
quantity_vector: groundwater head at the SWAP-groundwater coupling interface

spatial_support.governed_stage0: One synthetic one-dimensional SWAP column coupled at its groundwater interface; Stage 0 treatment set

temporal_support.coupling_window_semantics: Each corrector replays from one immutable accepted origin; each accepted next window starts from current committed SWAP state and the actual previously accepted interface state.

temporal_numerical_allocation.quantity: groundwater head error attributable to time discretisation

transaction_and_mass_semantics.publication_rule: Accepted interface transfer is published exactly once after all participant preflights.
transaction_and_mass_semantics.accepted_state_rule: Rejected/intermediate correctors do not mutate accepted state; retry reconstructs from the last accepted state.
transaction_and_mass_semantics.cumulative_rule: Authoritative cumulative interface mass is the sum of accepted-window transfers only.

coupled_iteration_semantics.convergence_rule: MODFLOW nonlinear convergence AND SWAP-groundwater exchange consistency

explicitly_not_promoted_to_application_t.reason: These are execution/qualification controls in the restricted HYDRO-MEMORY evidence, not independently justified hydrological consequences of reduced-model structural error.

criteria_summary: Freatic GHG and GLG absolute-error gates with area-type-specific thresholds at 80% of measurement points plus median-error gates.
Freatic GHG-GLG dynamics deviation <25% at 80% of measurement points plus median-error gate.
Drought recession-gradient deviation <25% at 80% of measurement points.
First-aquifer mean-head and dynamics gates: 50 cm absolute / 35% dynamics at the stated population support.
Deep-aquifer mean-head and dynamics gates: 100 cm absolute / 50% dynamics at the stated population support.
external_downstream_application_endpoint.use: Direct end-to-end application acceptance for a matching LHM-like coupled system containing the reduced unsaturated-zone component.
external_downstream_application_endpoint.not_authorized_use: Not applicable to synthetic Reference-Richards error panels and not invertible to a portable interface-flux or component structural-error tolerance.

treatment_of_extremes.current_real_coupling_boundary: Arbitrary prescribed-head jumps are not admitted by F-GC44; larger jumps require separate qualification rather than tolerance relaxation.
treatment_of_extremes.stage0_treatment_range: Bounded by the frozen Stage 0 groundwater-depth treatments; no extrapolated ROM acceptance is implied.

frozen: transaction-safe accepted-state and exact-once authoritative interface-mass semantics

direct_application_route.rationale: The external criteria judge the final groundwater application outputs directly rather than allocating an internal reduced-component error.

SCI-P.name: Scientific soil-moisture/profile representation
intended_quantity_vector: timing of drying and wetting fronts

accepted_partial_application_endpoint.statistic: correlation between observed and calculated soil moisture
accepted_partial_application_endpoint.point_population_rule: correlation >= 0.6 for 80% of field-sensor measurement points
accepted_partial_application_endpoint.population_context: LHM validation population and distinguished Dutch area types
accepted_partial_application_endpoint.interpretation: Formal application/product validation criterion for temporal soil-moisture pattern at its stated support.

SCI-P.aggregation_rule: Only the LHM monthly growing-season correlation endpoint is independently specified; no defensible conversion to layerwise absolute errors is made.
SCI-P.treatment_of_extremes: No independent quantitative SCI-P extreme-state acceptance rule found.

frozen_acceptance_envelope.reusable_frozen_endpoint: The LHM monthly soil-moisture correlation criterion may be reused only for a separately declared LHM-like application endpoint, not as a surrogate for profile fidelity.
frozen_acceptance_envelope.reason: The requested scientific profile interpretation requires absolute/depth-resolved/timing semantics that the external criterion does not supply.

unresolved_requirements: Absolute soil-moisture or storage tolerance by depth support
Allowed timing error for wetting/drying fronts
Rule separating observation uncertainty from acceptable structural model error

cross_purpose_decision.why: GW-D now has a frozen direct LHM-like end-to-end application route plus bounded numerical/transaction authority, but synthetic/component-level Layer-ROM fidelity still lacks structural-error allocation. GW-R still lacks quantitative recharge-error authority. SCI-P has a formal monthly soil-moisture endpoint but not the requested profile/storage/front fidelity requirements.

scientifically_valid_terminal_results.GW-R: NO INDEPENDENT QUANTITATIVE APPLICATION AUTHORITY FOUND
scientifically_valid_terminal_results.GW-D: FROZEN DIRECT LHM-LIKE END-TO-END APPLICATION ENVELOPE; COMPONENT/SYNTHETIC STRUCTURAL ERROR BUDGET UNRESOLVED
scientifically_valid_terminal_results.SCI-P: PARTIAL APPLICATION ENDPOINT ONLY; NO PROFILE FIDELITY AUTHORITY
